title.en: Man charged in Washington state with starting largest wildfire in the area
title.zh: 华盛顿州一男子被控引发该地区最大野火

summary.en: Authorities in Washington state have charged a man with starting a wildfire that has burned nearly 4,000 acres and forced thousands to evacuate. The suspect reportedly has a prior conviction for shooting his father in Arizona after being asked to do dishes.
summary.zh: 华盛顿州当局指控一名男子纵火，该野火已烧毁近4,000英亩土地，并迫使数万人撤离。据报道，该嫌疑人此前曾因被父亲要求洗碗而在亚利桑那州枪击其父，并因此被定罪。

body.en: Suspect had a prior conviction for reportedly shooting his father in Arizona, after he told his son to do the dishes Authorities on Monday charged a man in Washington state with starting a wildfire that has consumed almost 4,000 acres and forced tens of thousands from their homes. Aaron F Farinacci, 37, of Spokane, was arrested and charged with first-degree arson for setting the Old Trails fire, the largest of three devastating wildfires burning through the region. Continue reading...
body.zh: 据报道，嫌疑人此前因在亚利桑那州枪杀了他的父亲而被定罪，此前他让儿子洗碗。当局周一指控华盛顿州一名男子引发了一场野火，这场野火已吞噬了近 4,000 英亩的土地，迫使数万人逃离家园。 37 岁的斯波坎人亚伦·F·法里纳奇 (Aaron F Farinacci) 因纵火 Old Trails 而被捕，并被指控犯有一级纵火罪，这是该地区发生的三场毁灭性野火中规模最大的一场。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The immense destruction caused by the wildfire, and the suspect's past actions, remind us how a seemingly small spark can ignite devastating consequences. Yahweh's wisdom teaches us the profound impact of our actions, urging us to consider the far-reaching effects of even minor choices.
reflection.zh: 这场野火造成的巨大破坏，以及嫌疑人过去的行径，提醒我们一个看似微小的火花也能引发毁灭性的后果。雅伟的智慧教导我们，我们的行为会产生深远的影响，敦促我们思考即使是微小选择的长远效应。

verse.textEn: The tongue is a small part of the body, but it makes great boasts. Consider what a great forest is set on fire by a small spark.
verse.textZh: 舌头在百体里也是最小的，却能说大话。看哪，最小的火能点着最大的树林。

title.en: Is Bangladesh backtracking on post-Hasina reforms?
title.zh: 孟加拉国是否会在哈西娜后的改革中倒退？

summary.en: Two years after a student-led uprising toppled PM Sheikh Hasina, critics say Bangladesh's reform momentum is fading as political divisions deepen and key changes stall.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Two years after a student-led uprising toppled PM Sheikh Hasina, critics say Bangladesh's reform momentum is fading as political divisions deepen and key changes stall.

Just two years after a student-led uprising ended the nearly 16-year rule of Sheikh Hasina , many fear Bangladesh is slipping backward.

With Hasina, now in exile in India , planning a return in December and critics accusing the current government of failing to deliver on its promises, the country's political future is once again in doubt.

"At the end of the day, we did not see the elimination of discrimination, the creation of an inclusive society, or the new political order that was promised," Mohammad Tanzimuddin Khan, a professor of international relations at Dhaka University, told DW.

"It seems we are forgetting the very reasons behind the uprising of last July, especially those who came to power."

The protest movement began in 2018 over a controversial quota system for government jobs. In 2024, a court-backed move to reinstate parts of the system sparked fresh demonstrations that grew into a wider anti-government uprising .

In August 2024, after more than 1,000 people were killed in the unrest , then Prime Minister Hasina fled to India .

Bangladesh's interim government , which was led by Nobel Peace Prize winner Muhammad Yunus and backed by the military and key figures from the uprising, facilitated the signing of a reform roadmap. It was named the "July Charter" after the month when the uprising that toppled Hasina began. 

In a February 2026 referendum, around 70% of voters approved the charter, which proposed term limits for prime ministers, the creation of an upper house of parliament, stronger presidential powers and greater judicial independence.

The Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) won a decisive majority in a general election that took place alongside the referendum .

Critics say the BNP has since failed to implement several pre-election reform commitments.

Ali Riaz, who led the interim government's Constitution Reform Commission, said there had been "time-bound commitments," including the creation of a constitutional reform council and steps to implement reforms within 180 working days.

The interim government introduced 133 ordinances as part of its reform agenda, but after the BNP came to power, it refused to adopt 20 of them — including measures concerning the National Human Rights Commission (NHRC), the Anti-Corruption Commission, enforced disappearances and referendums.

The BNP argues that constitutional and institutional changes should be enacted through proper legislative procedures in Parliament.

body.zh: 学生领导的起义推翻了总理谢赫·哈西娜两年后，批评者表示，随着政治分歧加深和关键变革停滞，孟加拉国的改革势头正在减弱。 学生领导的起义结束了谢赫·哈西娜近 16 年的统治仅仅两年后，许多人担心孟加拉国正在倒退。 目前流亡印度的哈西娜计划于 12 月回国，批评者指责现任政府未能兑现承诺，该国的政治未来再次受到质疑。 达卡大学国际关系教授穆罕默德·坦齐穆丁·汗 (Mohammad Tanzimuddin Khan) 告诉德国之声：“最终，我们没有看到消除歧视、创建包容性社会，也没有看到承诺的新政治秩序。” “我们似乎忘记了去年七月起义背后的真正原因，尤其是那些上台的人。” 抗议运动始于 2018 年，抗议政府工作配额制度颇具争议。 2024 年，一项由法院支持的恢复部分系统的举措引发了新的示威活动，并发展成为更广泛的反政府起义。 2024年8月，在骚乱中造成1000多人死亡后，时任总理哈西娜逃往印度。 孟加拉国临时政府由诺贝尔和平奖得主穆罕默德·尤努斯领导，并得到军方和起义关键人物的支持，推动了改革路线图的签署。它以推翻哈西娜的起义开始的月份命名为“七月宪章”。 在 2026 年 2 月的全民公投中，约 70% 的选民批准了该宪章，其中提出了总理任期限制、设立议会上院、更强的总统权力和更大的司法独立。 孟加拉国民族主义党（BNP）在与公投同时举行的大选中赢得了决定性多数。 批评人士称，法国国民党此后未能履行多项选举前的改革承诺。 临时政府宪法改革委员会主席阿里·里亚兹表示，已经做出了“有时限的承诺”，包括成立宪法改革委员会以及在 180 个工作日内实施改革的步骤。 临时政府出台了 133 项法令作为其改革议程的一部分，但在 BNP 上台后，拒绝通过其中 20 项法令，其中包括涉及国家人权委员会 (NHRC)、反腐败委员会、强迫失踪和公投的措施。 法国国民党认为，宪法和制度变革应通过议会适当的立法程序来实施。 法国国民党和反对派伊斯兰大会党领导的联盟在《七月宪章》上发生冲突，其中包括召开制宪会议的提议……

title.en: World's oldest president reshuffles army as his absence stokes unease
title.zh: 世界上最年长的总统因缺席引发不安而改组军队

summary.en: Cameroon's president has been absent for two months while his team denies rumours about his health.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Cameroon's veteran leader Paul Biya - who has not been seen in public for nearly two months - has reshuffled the country's military amid growing concerns over his prolonged stay abroad.

The 93-year-old president appointed officials to key positions within the army and promoted five colonels to the rank of brigadier general.

One of the newly promoted brigadier generals is Raymond Jean Charles Beko'o Abondo, who was immediately reappointed as commander of the elite presidential guard - responsible for protecting Biya - a position he has occupied since 2013.

Such shake-ups are not unusual under Biya's administration, particularly at times of intense public scrutiny or perceived weakness.

After an unexpected coup three years ago in neighbouring Gabon, which toppled the Bongo dynasty sending shockwaves across the continent, Cameroon immediately reshuffled its military leadership.

Then, while running for a controversial eighth term in power at last year's presidential election, Biya reshuffled the top brass of the army.

Again in June this year, he promoted several members of the defence and security forces to higher ranks.

The circumstances under which the latest changes were made have sparked debate, especially among social media users.

Biya made the appointments in separate decrees on Monday from the Swiss city of Geneva, where he has been staying since leaving Cameroon on 7 June for what his team described as a "brief private stay".

Many in Cameroon have criticised the lack of information about his activities and the uncertainty surrounding the duration of his foreign trip.

After last year's election, he promised to name a new cabinet, but has yet to do so. A new post of vice-president that was created this April remains unfilled.

During his nearly 60-day period abroad so far, he has signed several other decrees, including some authorising his government to sign loan agreements with international financial institutions.

His absence sparked further speculation about his health, but the government has continually debunked reports that the head of state has been in hospital.

Press freedom groups were outraged when it was announced two years ago that the media in Cameroon were banned from reporting on Biya's health .

Cameroon's Communication Minister René Emmanuel Sadi has said the president is alive and will be returning to the country soon, during an interview with French-language broadcaster RFI.

He also dismissed allegations by the opposition that the nonagenarian leader's absence amounted to a vacancy at the helm of the state, saying Biya continues to work from Geneva.

But President Biya's continuing absence means Cameroon has a "glaring institutional vacuum", says the opposition CRM party's vice-president, Mamadou Mota.

title.en: More than 150 migrants rescued after boat catches fire in Channel
title.zh: 超过150名移民在英吉利海峡船只起火后获救

summary.en: French authorities reported that more than 150 migrants were rescued after their boat caught fire while attempting to cross the Channel to the UK.
summary.zh: 法国当局报告称，一艘载有移民的船只在试图穿越英吉利海峡前往英国时发动机起火，超过150名移民获救。

body.en:
More than 150 migrants have been rescued after the boat they were using to cross the Channel caught fire on Tuesday morning, French authorities have said.

The boat was attempting to cross to the UK when its engine caught fire, according to the French maritime prefecture of the Channel and North Sea.

It said 157 people have been rescued and are being taken to port in Boulogne-sur-Mer. There are no reports of anyone having been injured or killed.

It comes just a day after Prime Minister Andy Burnham pledged his government will be "relentless" in curbing the number of people arriving in the UK on small boats.

Overnight "five people on board the vessel required rescue... the remaining people on board refused the assistance offered by the French patrol boats", the French maritime prefecture said.

"Determined to reach the United Kingdom, migrants crossing the Channel in small boats refused assistance offered by French emergency service, accepting it only in situations of extreme emergency," it said in a statement.

Because of the "structural fragility" of boats used to cross the Channel, it said they decided not to intervene further at that stage.

But this morning the engine caught fire and the "vessel's integrity deteriorated very rapidly".

Rescue boats went to the scene from France and the UK, including the RNLI Eastbourne lifeboat and the UK Border Force vessels BSC Contender and BSC Courageous.

All of them are being taken to Boulogne-sur-Mer for treatment, where they were expected to arrive there at 12:30 local time (11:30 BST) on Tuesday.

A UK government spokesperson said the Border Security Command was alerted to an incident in the Channel this morning "concerning a migrant small boat in distress in French waters".

It said British vessels assisted in the operation, adding that so far there have been no fatalities reported.

They added that the incident "underlines the terrible dangers of small boat crossings".

"We continue to work relentlessly with the French and our partners overseas to prevent these perilous journeys," they said.

Earlier, the UK Coastguard said: "A vessel caught fire earlier this morning whilst in the French search and rescue region. UK vessels and a lifeboat are assisting."

title.en: Ukraine hits more Wildberries sites as strike kills five in Moscow region

body.en:
Two Wildberries warehouses were hit by Ukrainian strikes overnight on Monday, with another site apparently linked to Russia's largest online retailer also damaged near Moscow.

Ukraine has been targeting facilities operated by the company - often dubbed the "Russian Amazon" - in recent weeks.

At least five people were killed and 10 more injured at an industrial site about 69km (43 miles) south of the Kremlin, local officials said, without confirming it was run by Wildberries.

Elsewhere, officials did confirm two other Wildberries sites were hit in the St Petersburg and Tver regions.

Russia's defence ministry said it had intercepted and destroyed 320 drones overnight.

Meanwhile, strikes launched by Russia across Ukraine killed at least four people.

Moscow region governor Andrei Vorobyov said a warehouse was hit and caught fire, at an industrial site in Chekhov on the outskirts of Moscow, while an electrical substation and an administration building were also damaged.

He wrote on Telegram that seven of the 10 people injured were in a moderate condition, with one in a serious condition.

Ukrainian media reported that the warehouse site was linked to Wildberries. It was listed on Russia's Yandex search engine as being associated with the company.

The company has not commented publicly but confirmed its facility in the St Petersburg region was hit.

A video from social media, verified by the Reuters news agency, showed a Wildberries warehouse burning and a large plume of dark smoking coming from the building.

The governor of the Tver region said a Wildberries facility had also been damaged there overnight.

Local officials in the Samara region confirmed on Tuesday that a warehouse operated by Wilberries that was hit by Ukrainian drones on Sunday had been completely destroyed, along with all the goods stored there, Russian state news agency Tass reported.

Meanwhile, Ukraine's State Emergency Service said an 89-year-old woman was killed and two girls, aged two and 12, were among seven injured in a Russian strike on the southern port city of Mykolaiv overnight.

A woman and two girls, aged five and 10, were killed in a strike on a residential area in Sumy, and another four people were injured, it said.

Russian strikes also injured two people in the city of Bilhorod-Dnistrovskyi, while a food warehouse was set on fire in Dnipro, according to the State Emergency Service.

It comes a day after a busy beach in southern Russia was hit by a drone, killing seven people and injuring 58, according to Russian officials.

Social media footage verified by the BBC shows a drone crashing and exploding on a beach in the Krasnodar region as tourists look on from the shore and in the water.

title.en: Spain clashes with EU countries in heated talks over migration fallout

summary.en: An estimated 60,000 people rushed into Spain's North African territory, causing major concerns throughout the European Union.
summary.zh: 估计有六万人涌入西班牙的北非领土，引发了整个欧盟的重大关切。

body.en:
Spain's interior minister headed into a tense face-off with EU counterparts on Tuesday, as the bloc sought to draw lessons from an influx of migrants into Spain's North African enclave of Ceuta in hastily arranged video talks.

The unprecedented sight of an estimated 60,000 people streaming into Ceuta from Morocco — dozens died in the attempt and almost all have since left — exposed the fault lines on migration among EU nations.

Since images first emerged of the mass arrivals, most of whom swam around a barrier separating the enclave from Morocco, the Spanish government has found itself pitted against many of its EU partners.

The bloc's interior ministers dialled in for a videoconference that could provide a chance to look for common ground — but looked equally likely to set the stage for a showdown.

While Spain moved swiftly to send migrants back from Ceuta — where it said an estimated 2,500 remained as of Monday — the government of Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez backs a more open approach to migration than most of its EU counterparts.

Countries pushing a harder line are led most vocally by Italy — whose Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has attacked Madrid's stance, and specifically a recent push to grant legal status to undocumented migrants already in the country.

Both Italy and Denmark last week advocated suspending Spain from the Schengen free-travel area over the Ceuta crisis — a notion firmly rejected by Madrid, and which in any case is legally impossible under EU rules.

In a letter to the heads of the EU's institutions Saturday, Sanchez accused fellow EU countries of having "selfish" attitudes and called for emergency talks to work on a "common response" to such incidents.

Within hours, 22 countries led by Italy, Denmark, Germany and Hungary sent a counter-letter also demanding urgent talks, but with a different goal: to continue pressing their tough stance on immigration.

In a taste of what to expect, preparatory talks among the bloc's EU ambassadors on Monday saw Spain's envoy voice "frustration" with a perceived lack of support from fellow capitals, one EU diplomat told the Agence-France Presse (AFP) news agency.

Conversely — while all assured Madrid of their "solidarity" — some member states "are asking themselves if recent policies adopted by Spain have not sent the signal that the doors are open", added the diplomat.

The EU has significantly tightened its migration rules in recent months, including by allowing member states to send failed asylum seekers to so-called "return hubs" located outside the bloc's borders.

title.en: Guatemala volcano eruption sends lava spewing into the air
title.zh: 危地马拉火山喷发，岩浆喷涌而出

summary.en: Guatemala's Fuego stratovolcano, one of Central America's most active and a popular hiking destination, has erupted, sending lava spewing into the air.
summary.zh: 危地马拉的富埃戈层状火山是中美洲最活跃的火山之一，也是徒步旅行的热门地点，目前已喷发，岩浆喷涌而出。

body.en:
The eruption of the Fuego volcano in Guatemala has triggered the evacuation of at least two villages on its slopes.

Fuego, one of the most active volcanoes in the Western Hemisphere, started spewing lava and ash on Monday.

Pyroclastic currents - rivers of gas, volcanic ash and rock fragments - continued to flow down Fuego's south-eastern slope early on Tuesday, the government agency which monitors its activity said.

Disaster management agency Conred issued a nationwide orange alert, the second highest, and warned locals to be prepared as the eruptions could create further pyroclastic flows and billowing ash clouds.

Conred urged people to keep their windows and doors closed and lessons have been cancelled in schools close to the volcano.

Fuego is located just 16km (10 miles) west of Antigua, a city popular with tourists, who travel to the Unesco World Heritage Site to admire its colonial-era architecture.

Conred warned visitors and locals alike to refrain from approaching or remaining in areas at risk, in particular on the volcano's slopes.

More than 200 people were killed when Fuego erupted in 2018, many of them caught in the fast-flowing pyroclastic flows which raced down the Las Lajas ravine.
body.zh: 危地马拉富埃戈火山的喷发已导致山坡上至少两个村庄撤离。 富埃戈火山是西半球最活跃的火山之一，周一开始喷出熔岩和火山灰。 负责监测火山活动的政府机构表示，火山碎屑流——由气体、火山灰和岩石碎片组成的河流——周二早些时候继续沿着富埃戈岛东南斜坡流下。 灾害管理机构康雷德发布了全国范围内第二高的橙色警报，并警告当地人做好准备，因为火山喷发可能会产生进一步的火山碎屑流和滚滚火山灰云。 康雷德敦促人们关闭门窗，火山附近学校的课程已取消。 富埃戈位于安提瓜以西仅 16 公里（10 英里）处，安提瓜是一座深受游客欢迎的城市，他们前往联合国教科文组织世界遗产地欣赏其殖民时代的建筑。 康雷德警告游客和当地人不要接近或停留在危险地区，特别是火山斜坡上。 2018 年富埃戈火山喷发造成 200 多人死亡，其中许多人被困在沿着拉斯拉哈斯峡谷快速流动的火山碎屑流中。

reflection.en: The powerful eruption of the Fuego volcano reminds us of the raw, untamed forces within creation. Yahweh's word tells us that creation itself groans, awaiting its full redemption, a truth often felt acutely in the face of such natural spectacles. This event invites us to reflect on the world's inherent fragility and the hope for ultimate renewal.
reflection.zh: 富埃戈火山的剧烈喷发提醒我们，创造界中蕴藏着原始而未被驯服的力量。雅伟的话语告诉我们，受造之物本身都在叹息，等候完全的救赎，这在面对此类自然奇观时尤为真切。这一事件邀请我们反思世界的固有脆弱性，以及对最终更新的盼望。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Iran: Is Reza Pahlavi's political star fading?
title.zh: 伊朗：礼萨·巴列维的政治明星正在衰落吗？

summary.en: Once seen as a leading opposition figure, Pahlavi now faces questions about his political relevance in Western capitals and inside Iran.

body.en:
Once seen as a leading opposition figure, Pahlavi now faces questions about his political relevance in Western capitals and inside Iran.

An investigation by Reuters news agency into Reza Pahlavi , the son of the last shah of Iran , has raised a question: has Iran's most prominent opposition figure abroad lost credibility and influence among Western policymakers and Iranians?

Reuters reported in July that Pahlavi's candidacy had "sputtered" after appearing to reach its high point earlier this year.

Although he has repeatedly declared his readiness to lead Iran through a transitional period, senior US officials have publicly distanced themselves from the prospect of a US-backed effort to bring Pahlavi to power.

The Reuters report notes that critics accuse Pahlavi of relying too heavily on foreign military intervention and failing to build a lasting political coalition.

During periods of heightened tensions, Pahlavi welcomed international pressure on the Islamic Republic.

In January 2026, he told Iranians that the international community had entered the stage of action and echoed US President Donald Trump's message that help was "on its way."

"Great nation of Iran, the eyes of the world are upon you. Take to the streets, and as a united front, shout your demands," Pahlavi wrote on X. 

After the military conflict  failed to bring about the collapse of the Iranian government and criticism intensified over the consequences of war, Pahlavi said that "the final victory will still be forged by our hands" and that it was the Iranian people who would "finish the job."

The main responsibility, he said, remained with the Iranian people themselves. Some critics argued that this emphasis on the role of the Iranian people marked a retreat from his earlier messaging about international help.

Mojtaba Najafi, a researcher focusing on political and social movements in Iran, argues that Western governments have never regarded Pahlavi as a truly viable option.

"A serious alternative would need the capacity to gain and manage power, influence existing power structures and offer a realistic prospect of structural political change," Najafi said. "Western governments have never considered Pahlavi to have met these criteria."

Najafi distinguishes between Europe and the United States. "European governments primarily approach Iran from the perspective of stability," he said, pointing to migration, geopolitical and security concerns, and the containment of radicalism and terrorism.

The researcher argues that, in the United States, pragmatic forces favor an accommodation with elements of the Islamic Republic.

title.en: 'Urgent' call for military build-up in Australia's backyard amid Chinese, Russian threats
title.zh: 在中国和俄罗斯的威胁下，“紧急”呼吁在澳大利亚后院进行军事集结

summary.en: Tensions are rising in the Pacific region as distrust among key players sees one country undertake a drastic push to rearm.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Japan needs to boost its military with a "sense of urgency and crisis", its defence minister said on Tuesday, as a new government assessment reiterated growing risks from China, North Korea, and Russia.

Japan is already beefing up military spending and security cooperation in Asia, deploying missile launchers to outer islands, moving to acquire "counter-strike" capabilities, and easing rules on weapons exports.

But Shinjiro Koizumi said in a preface to the annual defence white paper that it was "imperative that Japan further reinforce and transform its defense capabilities with a stronger sense of urgency and crisis than ever before".

In the Asia-Pacific "not only are China and North Korea further strengthening their military capabilities, China-Russia and Russia-North Korea are also reinforcing their cooperation", he added.

The new white paper said China was "intensifying its activities" in the region around Japan, "extending beyond the so-called first island chain to the second island chain".

Japanese jets scrambled 595 times in the year to March 31, 2026, including 366 sorties against Chinese aircraft and 214 for Russian planes.

Japan decided in April to lift its self-imposed ban on weapons exports, but the white paper highlighted problems in the country's production base that could jeopardise procurement and innovation.

Koizumi also said that he and US counterpart Pete Hegseth had "exchanged candid views" on the "unwavering" US-Japan alliance, while also increasing security cooperation with the Philippines, Australia, and South Korea to realise a "a Free and Open Indo-Pacific".

"As the security environment becomes increasingly and rapidly severe, what is required now is to strengthen resilience against crises all across the entire Indo-Pacific region," Koizumi said.

"In order to do so Japan will build and expand multilayered networks among allies and like-minded countries, and enhance interconnectivity with like-minded countries and others in every area."

The link between defence and future prosperity comes as Takaichi's administration prepares a new national security strategy.

Military experts expect it to call for further spending increases aimed primarily at deterring China from starting a conflict with Taiwan that could also draw Japan into a prolonged war.

title.en: The concerning question around photos of a detained world leader
title.zh: 围绕被拘留的世界领导人照片的令人担忧的问题

summary.en: The ousted leader appeared to be in good health, her son said, but separate worries have been raised.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Photographs of Myanmar's detained former leader Aung San Suu Kyi meeting with an aid agency have been released, a visit her son described as "extremely meaningful".

It is the first independent confirmation of her condition in years as uncertainty over the health and well-being of the 81-year-old Nobel Peace Prize winner continued to grow.

Suu Kyi has been detained since February 2021, when Myanmar's military ousted her elected civilian government in a dawn coup , plunging the impoverished Southeast Asian nation into turmoil.

The whereabouts of the former head of Myanmar's pro-Democracy party, who has a large global following, have remained largely unknown since then.

Suu Kyi's son, Kim Aris, told the Reuters news agency that the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) had not been allowed to have a physician examine his mother, but said she appeared to be in good health and good spirits.

"It's the first independent proof that I've had that she's actually alive for a long time now," he said in London.

Mon Zin, an Australian-based lawyer who fled Myanmar in the 1990s with her family, told SBS News the photos offer "relief" to her supporters.

Zin is the daughter of democracy activists who fled Myanmar for Australia in 1996, where she was enrolled in Year 10.

Three decades on, she is now a lawyer and regularly contributes to analysis pieces for geopolitical publications.

She told SBS News that Suu Kyi is an "admired figure" across Asia for her decades of opposing despotism in Myanmar.

"We have always admired Aung San Suu Kyi's resilience and strength. For the people of Myanmar and many in the resistance movement, when they saw the photograph, it brought them genuine relief," she said.

One of four photographs released by the Myanmar government showed Suu Kyi in traditional Burmese dress, standing unaided and shaking hands with an ICRC representative.

Another showed the pair seated in a sparsely furnished, wood-panelled room with only two chairs and a desk.

"Timing is everything. Those who control when information is released often shape how it is interpreted and, in doing so, influence the narrative," she said.

"The junta chose to publicise a carefully managed humanitarian meeting with the ICRC, projecting humanitarian optics while continuing to deny political access to ASEAN, foreign diplomats and even her own family," Zin said.

"While many of us were relieved to see Aung San Suu Kyi alive, it is equally important to ask: Why was this information released at this particular moment?"

title.en: Nauru has become Naoero, the latest nation to join a growing cultural trend
title.zh: 瑙鲁更名为瑙埃罗，加入日益增长的文化趋势

summary.en: The island nation of Nauru has officially reverted to its original name, the Republic of Naoero, reflecting a broader global trend of nations reclaiming their indigenous cultural identities.
summary.zh: 瑙鲁岛国已正式恢复其原名瑙埃罗共和国，这反映了全球范围内各国重新认同其本土文化身份的趋势。

body.en:
The Pacific island nation of Nauru has officially changed its name to the Republic of Naoero, reverting to its traditional designation in a move it said was aimed at strengthening national identity and cultural heritage.

Nauru's parliament passed a constitutional amendment in May to rename the country, initially planning a national referendum. However, President David Adeang said in a social media post last week that the referendum plans have been dropped.

"The decision not to pursue a referendum was reached after thoughtful deliberation that Naoero is not a new name seeking acceptance by the people," Adeang said.

"It is already the identity of the people, is on the national coat of arms, and spoken in the community; and importantly is allowed by the constitution."

The abbreviated name will be "Naoero", while citizens will be referred to as "dei-Naoero".

European colonisers changed the country's name to Nauru after finding it difficult to pronounce the island's native name Naoero.

The nation is the world's third-smallest after Vatican City and Monaco, with a population of about 12,000.

Adeang said the decision was not about politics but about identity, heritage, and "preserving the legacy of our ancestors and strengthening the future of our children".

The government has formally notified international organisations and countries of the change, with the transition process already underway.

Over the last 50 years, a trend of smaller nations asserting their independence from old colonial empires has given rise to a growing cultural trend — the national name change.

For many nations like Naoero, the desire to revert to its original, pre-colonial name is about cementing a sense of national identity or pride.

Timor-Leste adopted its current name — a Portuguese tautology in which both words mean "East" — in 2002. It was previously known as Timor Timur — its Indonesian name that, funnily enough, also meant "East East" — from 1975 until independence.

Tuvalu and Kiribati took back their names in 1978 and 1979 respectively, doing away with colonial names the Ellice Islands and Gilbert Islands.

Vanuatu followed suit in 1980, retiring the name New Hebrides after becoming independent.

Overseas, Türkiye was among the most recent major nations to change its name.

Its campaign for a name change started in 2021 when Turkish president Recep Erdoğan began asking various international bodies to observe the traditional spelling and pronunciation.

Erdoğan's feeling was that the name Türkiye represented "the culture, civilisation and values of the Turkish nation in...
body.zh: 太平洋岛国瑙鲁已正式更名为纳奥罗共和国，恢复其传统名称，据称此举旨在加强国家认同和文化遗产。 瑙鲁议会五月通过宪法修正案，重新命名国家，最初计划举行全民公投。然而，总统戴维·阿迪昂上周在社交媒体帖子中表示，公投计划已被放弃。 阿迪昂说：“经过深思熟虑，纳奥罗并不是一个寻求人民接受的新名字，因此决定不进行公投。” “这已经是人民的身份，印在国徽上，并在社区中使用；重要的是得到了宪法的允许。” 缩写名称为“Naoero”，而公民将被称为“dei-Naoero”。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 欧洲殖民者发现该岛的原名纳奥罗 (Naoero) 很难发音，因此将该国改名为瑙鲁 (Nauru)。 该国是世界上第三小的国家，仅次于梵蒂冈城和摩纳哥，人口约为 12,000 人。 阿迪昂表示，这一决定与政治无关，而是关于身份、遗产以及“保护我们祖先的遗产并加强我们孩子的未来”。 政府已正式向国际组织和国家通报这一变化，过渡进程已经启动。 过去 50 年来，小国主张摆脱旧殖民帝国独立的趋势引发了一种日益增长的文化趋势——国家名称变更。 对于像 Naoero 这样的许多国家来说，恢复其原始的、前殖民时期的名称的愿望是为了巩固民族认同感或自豪感。 东帝汶于 2002 年采用了现在的名称——葡萄牙语同义反复，两个词的意思都是“东方”。从 1975 年直到独立，它以前被称为“Timor Timur”——它的印尼语名称，有趣的是，也有“东方”的意思。 图瓦卢和基里巴斯分别于1978年和1979年收回了自己的名字，废除了殖民地名称埃利斯群岛和吉尔伯特群岛。 1980年，瓦努阿图效仿，独立后不再使用新赫布里底群岛这个名字。 在海外，土耳其是最近更名的主要国家之一。 它的更名运动始于 2021 年，当时土耳其总统雷杰普·埃尔多安开始要求各个国际机构遵守传统的拼写和发音。 埃尔多安的感觉是，Türkiye 这个名字代表了“土耳其民族的文化、文明和价值观......

reflection.en: Nauru's decision to reclaim its original name, Naoero, speaks to the deep human desire to honor heritage and affirm identity. Yahweh, who "made all the nations... and marked out their appointed times in history and the boundaries of their lands," acknowledges the unique story and place of every people. This act reminds us that each nation has a distinct...
reflection.zh: 瑙鲁决定恢复其原名瑙埃罗，这反映了人类尊重传统和确认身份的深切愿望。雅伟“从一人造出万族，使他们住在全地上，并且预先定准他们的年限和所住的疆界”，承认每个民族独特的历史和地位。这一举动提醒我们，每个国家都有其独特的起源和值得传承的文化遗产。

title.en: Dry Danube River threatens nuclear power in Romania, Hungary
title.zh: 多瑙河干涸威胁罗马尼亚和匈牙利核电站

summary.en: Low water levels in the Danube River are impacting nuclear power generation in Hungary and Romania. Hungary's Paks plant is operating at reduced capacity, while Romania's military has intervened to improve water flow to the Cernavoda plant.
summary.zh: 多瑙河水位下降正在影响匈牙利和罗马尼亚的核电生产。匈牙利的帕克斯核电站目前以约10%的容量运行，而罗马尼亚军方已采取措施，炸毁岩石以改善切尔纳沃德核电站的水流。

body.zh: 由于缺乏冷却河水，匈牙利帕克斯核电站的运行能力约为 10%。在罗马尼亚，军方炸毁了一块岩石露头，以改善切尔纳沃达核电站的水流量。 由于天气持续炎热干燥，多瑙河和其他水道水位创历史新低，一些中欧和东欧国家正面临电力短缺和对工业的影响。 匈牙利勉强避免了关闭其唯一的核电站，但仍将其发电量降至一小部分。在罗马尼亚，海军拆除了多瑙河河床上裸露的岩石露头，试图改善水流。 在塞尔维亚，水力发电量受到干旱的严重影响。 预计本周天气将持续炎热干燥，但几乎没有缓解的迹象。 罗马尼亚军方引爆了多瑙河支流上因水位低而暴露的岩石露头，试图改善切尔纳沃达核电站的冷却水流量，该核电站通常供应该国约五分之一的电力。 士兵们在上游约 50 公里（约 30 英里）处引爆了一块岩石。这些碎片将被带到一个战略地点并沉入水中以帮助提高水位。 国防部长拉杜·米鲁塔 (Radu Miruta) 表示，此次行动取得了成功，并表示军方数十年来一直在等待进入并拆除岩石的机会。 米鲁塔说，如果部分水转移失败，该工厂可能不得不在周四之前完全关闭。 看守总理伊利·博洛扬 (Ilie Bolojan) 表示，在与能源密集型行业代表召开危机会议后，汽车制造商达西亚 (Dacia) 和福特 (Ford) 已同意暂停在罗马尼亚的生产直至 8 月 19 日。他表示其他公司也会采取类似的措施。 匈牙利总理彼得·马扎尔表示，上周最初宣布的帕克斯核电站周一全面关闭的情况是有可能避免的。 但这个拥有四个反应堆的发电站通常产生匈牙利近一半的电力生产和约三分之一的电力消耗，但周一的运行能力略高于 10%。 匈牙利已要求工业用户抑制消费，并要求家庭自愿储蓄。周一，电动货运列车也被停运，以减少电网负荷。 “我们已经进入关键时期。由于自我克制，网络稳定，目前消耗量远低于计划水平。最后一台 Paks 涡轮机已投入运行。我很快就会从（电网运营商）MAVIR 控制室报告。”他说。 马扎尔周一早些时候还表示，“未来的水资源管理预测......

reflection.en: The struggle to keep nuclear plants running due to low river levels reminds us of our ancient call to care for creation. Yahweh placed humanity in the garden to “work it and keep it,” a responsibility that extends to managing our resources and infrastructure wisely in a changing world. This news underscores our deep dependence on the natural systems Yahweh...
reflection.zh: 河流水位下降导致核电站难以运行，这提醒我们人类古老的呼召——看护受造界。雅伟将人类安置在伊甸园中，“耕作并看守”，这项责任延伸到在不断变化的世界中明智地管理我们的资源和基础设施。这则新闻强调了我们对雅伟所设计的自然系统的深度依赖。

title.en: Ceuta: EU calls borders a 'shared European responsibility'
title.zh: 休达：欧盟称边境是“共同的欧洲责任”

summary.en: The European Commission has offered Morocco increased assistance for border security at Ceuta and Melilla, advocating for a unified approach from the EU member states. Interior ministers are scheduled to discuss this matter on Tuesday.

title.en: Can PM Modi reconnect with India's Gen Z?
title.zh: 莫迪总理能否与印度的Z世代重新建立联系？

summary.en: Student protests in India have highlighted a growing gap between Prime Minister Narendra Modi's BJP party and the nation's young people. Experts suggest that superficial engagement, such as through social media, will not be sufficient to bridge this divide.
summary.zh: 印度学生抗议活动揭示了总理纳伦德拉·莫迪领导的印度人民党与印度年轻人之间日益扩大的隔阂。专家指出，仅靠Instagram短视频等表面接触不足以弥合这一分歧。

body.en:
Student protests exposed a growing disconnect between PM Narendra Modi's BJP and young Indians. Experts say Instagram reels alone won't close it.

As students filled India's streets to demand accountability from the government , Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi seemed to have realized that he needed to connect more effectively with the country's youth.

Modi posted on Instagram a rare selfie video in which he said he was pained by their suffering and promised remedial steps. But it was not enough to satisfy the protesters' concerns, and five Gen Z-style reels later, that gap seems as wide as ever.

"We ain't friends," one comment under the first reel read. It echoed thousands of others reacting to a midnight video drop from the PM. 

In one of Modi's lesser-produced videos, he addressed the youth as "friends" before finally speaking about the exam at the center of the protests.

It was the prime minister’s response to the biggest political crisis he has faced in his third term so far, over a cancelled high-stakes medical entrance exam which affected millions of aspirants.

Since the first video, he's improved camera angles and lighting, tried varied backgrounds, and even started and ended the videos himself like a one-man content creator. The response remains tepid.

For Modi's ruling Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), the protests came at the peak of its power, but the unrest has dimmed that shine, and the disconnect with the youth is substantial, experts told DW.

In 2024, the average age of MPs elected to India's Parliament reached a record 56 years, which is a problem, said Shipra Baduni, CEO of Young Leaders for Active Citizenship, because there is not much youth representation in the legislature. 

India has traditionally had vibrant youth participation at the university level, where student parties have long been affiliated with national and regional parties. 

"Student politics has not only given a pulse check, or given a platform for young people to be able to express frustration, or anger, or dissent," said Baduni. "It's also given some of these parties and leaders today."

"We've seen systematically over the last one decade that it has been cut down," she added. "There is a very evident push to say that students should only study, and there is no need for students to engage in politics."

"Where is the space for a young person to express their frustration? If you go on social media to criticize the government, there is a crackdown. Offices are screening your social media."

But Baduni believes the responsibility to connect with the youth doesn't lie with the central government alone: "It's the job of my ward councillor or my local elected leader to come out and say, 'let me talk to the young people in my locality,...
body.zh: 学生抗议暴露了纳伦德拉·莫迪总理领导的印度人民党与印度年轻人之间日益严重的脱节。专家表示，仅凭 Instagram 卷轴并不能关闭它。 当学生们涌上印度街头要求政府问责时，印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪似乎意识到他需要与该国的年轻人建立更有效的联系。 莫迪在 Instagram 上发布了一段罕见的自拍照视频，他在视频中表示，他对他们的痛苦感到痛苦，并承诺采取补救措施。但这还不足以满足抗议者的担忧，在五次 Z 世代风格的卷轴之后，这种差距似乎和以前一样大。 “我们不是朋友，”第一卷下的一条评论写道。这与数千人对总理午夜发布的视频的反应相呼应。 在莫迪制作较少的一段视频中，他将年轻人称为“朋友”，然后最后谈到了抗议活动中心的考试。 这是总理对他第三个任期迄今为止所面临的最大政治危机的回应，这场危机是因为高风险的医学入学考试被取消，影响了数百万有抱负的人。 自第一个视频以来，他改进了摄像机角度和灯光，尝试了不同的背景，甚至像一个单独的内容创作者一样自己开始和结束视频。反应依然不温不火。 专家告诉德国之声，对于莫迪领导的执政党印度人民党（BJP）来说，抗议活动正值其权力的顶峰，但骚乱已经削弱了它的光芒，而且与年轻人的脱节也很大。 积极公民青年领袖首席执行官希普拉·巴杜尼 (Shipra Baduni) 表示，2024 年，当选印度议会议员的平均年龄达到创纪录的 56 岁，这是一个问题，因为立法机构中的青年代表并不多。 印度传统上在大学层面上有充满活力的青年参与，学生政党长期以来一直隶属于国家和地区政党。 巴杜尼说：“学生政治不仅为年轻人提供了一个表达沮丧、愤怒或异议的平台。” “今天也给了其中一些政党和领导人。” “在过去的十年里，我们已经系统地看到它被削减了，”她补充道。 “有一种非常明显的推动力，即学生应该只学习，没有必要让学生参与政治。” “年轻人表达不满的空间在哪里？如果你在社交媒体上批评政府，就会遭到镇压。有关部门正在审查你的社交媒体。” 但巴杜尼认为，与年轻人建立联系的责任不仅仅在于中央政府：“我的选区议员或当地民选领导人的工作就是站出来说，‘让我与当地的年轻人交谈，......

reflection.en: This news highlights the vital role of vision in leadership, especially in connecting with younger generations. When a shared sense of purpose or moral compass is absent, communities can experience drift and disconnect. Yahweh's Word reminds us that without a clear vision, people may lose their way, underscoring the need for leaders to articulate a...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻突显了领导力中愿景的关键作用，尤其是在与年轻一代建立联系方面。当缺乏共同的使命感或道德指南时，社会群体可能会出现迷失和隔阂。雅伟的话语提醒我们，没有清晰的愿景，人们就可能失去方向，这强调了领导者需要阐明一个能与所有人产生共鸣的、引人入胜的未来。

reflection.zh: 人工智能经济的快速变化和不透明性，正如近期市场动荡所显示，突显了人类理解力在复杂系统面前的局限。当投资者努力理解不可预测的发展时，箴言3:5提醒我们不要依靠自己的聪明，而要全心信赖雅伟。这鼓励我们在自身洞察力有限时，保持谦卑并依靠神的智慧。

verse.textEn: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding.
verse.textZh: 你要专心仰赖雅伟，不可倚靠自己的聪明。

title.en: China has banned hidden retractable car door handles. How are they dangerous – and what will Australia do?
title.zh: 中国已禁止隐藏式可伸缩汽车门把手。它们为何危险？澳大利亚会效仿吗？

summary.en: China has banned hidden retractable car door handles, citing their failure to operate during accidents and trapping passengers in burning vehicles. These handles were popularized by Tesla electric vehicles, and the move raises questions about whether other countries like Australia will follow suit.
summary.zh: 中国已禁止使用隐藏式可伸缩汽车门把手，理由是它们在事故中可能失灵，导致乘客被困在燃烧的车辆中。特斯拉电动汽车普及了这种门把手，此举引发了其他国家（如澳大利亚）是否会效仿的疑问。

body.en: The handles, which were popularised by Elon Musk’s Tesla EVs, have a record of failing and trapping passengers inside burning vehicles during deadly accidents Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast They used to be a novelty in Australia: the futuristic, flush-mounted car door handles favoured by Elon Musk’s Tesla. However while the design – popularised with the Tesla Model S in 2012 and since adopted by other manufacturers – might look sleek, it may not be great in an emergency. Continue reading...
body.zh: 这些把手因埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的特斯拉电动汽车而广受欢迎，但在致命事故中曾发生过故障，并将乘客困在燃烧的车辆内。 关注我们的澳大利亚新闻直播博客，了解最新动态 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 它们曾经是澳大利亚的新奇事物：埃隆·马斯克 (Telsas) 青睐的未来派嵌入式汽车门把手。然而，虽然这种设计在 2012 年随特斯拉 Model S 流行起来，后来被其他制造商采用，但虽然看起来很时尚，但在紧急情况下可能不太好。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The ban on retractable car door handles highlights the importance of foresight in design and technology. A prudent person foresees danger and takes precautions, reminding us that innovation must always be balanced with safety and the well-being of others. This decision underscores the responsibility to protect lives by addressing foreseeable risks, even in...
reflection.zh: 对可伸缩汽车门把手的禁令突显了设计和技术中预见危险的重要性。通达人预见祸患就藏躲，提醒我们创新必须始终与安全和他人福祉相平衡。这一决定强调了通过解决可预见的风险来保护生命的责任，即使是在看似微小的设计选择中。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: China’s tech advances are causing chaos from Silicon Valley to the White House
title.zh: 中国的科技进步正在从硅谷到白宫引发混乱

summary.en: Recent advancements in China's artificial intelligence, chip manufacturing, and robotics technologies have caused significant disruption in global financial markets and the US tech industry.
summary.zh: 中国在人工智能、芯片制造和机器人技术方面取得的最新进展，已在全球金融市场和美国科技行业引发了显著的震荡。

body.en: New AI models, advanced robots and specialty computer chips are unsettling markets and the US tech industry Over the past month, a series of advancements in China’s artificial intelligence, chip manufacturing and robotics technologies have rattled financial markets, caused divisions among US tech moguls and left the Trump administration scrambling to respond. Silicon Valley has long pointed to China’s tech industry as a competitive threat and used its growth as rationale for why US firms should not face regulatory oversight that could slow them down. In recent weeks, however, China’s progress has pushed US tech CEOs past vague warnings and into open disagreement over how to address Chinese-made products upending their industry. Continue reading...
body.zh: 新的人工智能模型、先进机器人和专用计算机芯片令市场和美国科技行业感到不安。过去一个月，中国人工智能、芯片制造和机器人技术的一系列进步震惊了金融市场，引发了美国科技大亨之间的分歧，并让特朗普政府仓促应对。硅谷长期以来一直将中国科技行业视为竞争威胁，并以中国科技行业的增长作为美国企业不应面临可能放慢发展速度的监管监督的理由。然而，最近几周，中国的进步让美国科技公司的首席执行官不再发出含糊的警告，而是在如何解决颠覆其行业的中国制造产品问题上产生了公开分歧。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid pace of technological innovation, particularly in AI and robotics, reflects a time when knowledge is indeed increasing at an unprecedented rate. This acceleration can bring both wonder and apprehension as societies grapple with its profound implications. In such moments, we are reminded to seek wisdom beyond mere information, trusting Yahweh to...
reflection.zh: 人工智能和机器人技术等领域的快速创新步伐，正反映出知识以前所未有的速度增长的时代。这种加速既带来惊奇，也引发担忧，因为社会正在努力应对其深远影响。在这样的时刻，我们被提醒要寻求超越单纯信息的智慧，信靠雅伟引导我们穿越新的领域。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: World-renowned climber Nirmal Purja among 11 struck by avalanche on Pakistan mountain
title.zh: 世界著名登山家尼尔马尔·普尔贾等11人在巴基斯坦山脉遭遇雪崩

summary.en: World-renowned climber Nirmal Purja was among 11 mountaineers caught in a deadly avalanche on Broad Peak in Pakistan. Rescuers have found four bodies as the search continues for the team.
summary.zh: 世界著名登山家尼尔马尔·普尔贾是11名在巴基斯坦布洛阿特峰遭遇致命雪崩的登山者之一。救援人员已找到四具遗体，搜寻工作仍在进行中。

body.en: Rescuers say four bodies found in search for team caught in Broad Peak avalanche, after trackers showed rapid descent The world-renowned Nepali mountaineer Nirmal Purja – a former British special forces member – is among 11 climbers caught in a deadly avalanche on Pakistan’s Broad Peak. The Alpine Club of Pakistan said “seven climbers have been spotted via aerial drone footage” adding that “their identities and condition cannot yet be verified”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 救援人员称，在追踪器显示快速下降后，在寻找布洛阿特峰雪崩中陷入雪崩的登山队时，发现了四具尸体。世界著名的尼泊尔登山家尼尔马尔·普贾（Nirmal Purja）是一名前英国特种部队成员，他是巴基斯坦布洛阿特峰遭遇雪崩的 11 名登山者之一。巴基斯坦高山俱乐部表示，“通过无人机航拍发现了七名登山者”，并补充说“他们的身份和状况尚未得到证实”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The tragic news of climbers caught in an avalanche reminds us of life's fragility and the suddenness of loss. In moments of profound grief and pain, we hold onto the promise that one day Yahweh will wipe away every tear. This hope assures us that suffering, mourning, and death will ultimately pass away.
reflection.zh: 登山者遭遇雪崩的悲剧性新闻提醒我们生命的脆弱和失去的突然。在极度悲伤和痛苦的时刻，我们紧紧抓住雅伟有一天将擦去我们所有眼泪的应许。这个盼望向我们保证，苦难、哀伤和死亡终将过去。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: From petitions to memes: How students made dissent visible
title.zh: 从请愿到网络迷因：学生如何让异议显现

summary.en: Student movements throughout history, from imperial China to modern India, have consistently found new ways to express dissent and challenge established authority, adapting their methods to contemporary tools and symbols.
summary.zh: 从中国古代到当今印度，学生运动不断调整其工具和象征，以挑战权威，使异议得以显现。

body.en:
From imperial China to present-day India, student movements have repeatedly adapted the tools and symbols of their age to challenge authority.

On July 22, 2026, in rainy Mumbai, India , a casually dressed young woman stepped in front of a slow-moving police van carrying detained students. She placed her palm on the hood, forcing the vehicle to stop.

Mobile phones captured the moment from every angle. She too, raised her own phone and recorded the encounter. Within hours, the clip spread across India and beyond.

It became one of the defining visuals of the Cockroach Janta Party protests, a movement in which students demanded transparency and accountability, following leaks in India's medical entrance exams.

But the power of the moment lay not only in what she did, but in how quickly it was seen. A single gesture, a young woman confronting authority , became a symbol shared across millions of screens.

While the clip belongs to a generation raised on social media, the impulse behind it is much older.

From court petitions and revolutionary posters to photographs, umbrellas and memes, student movements have repeatedly adapted the tools and symbols available to them, turning them into vehicles for dissent.

Long before television or social media carried dissent across borders, students still found ways to make their grievances heard.

In Eastern Han China, for instance, scholars at the Imperial Academy (Taixue) aligned with reform-minded officials in opposing powerful eunuchs at court, whom many viewed as corrupt and politically overbearing.

They voiced their objections through public criticism, political networks and petitions.

In an era when political communication moved through official channels, petitions were among the established ways of bringing grievances before the throne. Written in formal language and delivered through the bureaucracy, they carried student concerns directly into the state's communication system.

In Paris in 1968, students challenged university authorities and a conservative postwar social order. As demonstrations spread across the French capital and drew in workers, one of the movement's most enduring contributions emerged from a basement workshop at the Ecole des Beaux-Arts.

The Atelier Populaire ("People's Workshop") printed thousands of posters during the protests, many of them overnight. Their bold graphics, silhouettes and slogans became the visual language of the movement. Produced collectively, many carried no individual author's name, helping transform protest into a shared public voice.

The posters and their messages could appear in dozens of places overnight, giving the protest a wide local visual presence.

Protests also became more impactful when images could be transmitted across borders.

body.zh: 从中华帝国到当今的印度，学生运动不断地采用他们那个时代的工具和符号来挑战权威。 2026 年 7 月 22 日，在多雨的印度孟买，一名穿着休闲的年轻女子走到一辆载着被拘留学生的缓慢行驶的警车前。她将手掌放在引擎盖上，迫使车辆停了下来。 手机从各个角度捕捉了这一时刻。她也举起了自己的手机，记录了这次遭遇。几个小时内，这段视频就传遍了印度及其他地区。 它成为蟑螂简塔党抗议活动的标志性视觉效果之一，在印度医学入学考试泄密后，学生们在这场运动中要求透明度和问责制。 但这一刻的​​力量不仅在于她所做的事情，还在于她的所作所为很快被人们看到。一个年轻女子对抗权威的一个动作，成为了数百万屏幕上共享的符号。 虽然这段视频属于在社交媒体上长大的一代人，但其背后的冲动却要古老得多。 从法庭请愿书和革命海报到照片、雨伞和模因，学生运动不断地调整他们可用的工具和符号，将它们变成异议的工具。 早在电视或社交媒体跨境传播异议之前，学生们就已经找到了表达不满的方法。 例如，在中国东汉，太学的学者与具有改革思想的官员结盟，反对宫廷中有权有势的宦官，许多人认为宦官腐败且在政治上专横。 他们通过公开批评、政治网络和请愿来表达他们的反对意见。 在政治沟通通过官方渠道进行的时代，请愿是向王室表达不满的既定方式之一。它们以正式语言编写并通过官僚机构传达，将学生的担忧直接传达到国家的沟通系统中。 1968 年的巴黎，学生们挑战大学当局和保守的战后社会秩序。随着示威活动在法国首都蔓延并吸引了工人，该运动最持久的贡献之一来自巴黎美术学院的一个地下室工作室。 Atelier Populaire（“人民工作室”）在抗议期间印制了数千张海报，其中许多是在一夜之间印制的。他们大胆的图形、轮廓和口号成为了这场运动的视觉语言。许多作品都是集体制作的，没有作者的名字，这有助于将抗议转变为公众的共同声音。 这些海报及其信息可能会在一夜之间出现在数十个地方，使抗议活动在当地得到广泛的关注。 当图像可以跨境传输时，抗议的影响力也变得更大。 在...

reflection.en: Student movements, by making their dissent visible, often echo a deep human longing for fairness and moral order. Yahweh, through the prophet Amos, calls for justice to flow powerfully and consistently, reminding us that true righteousness should be an undeniable force in society. This pursuit of a more just world often requires courage to speak truth to...
reflection.zh: 学生运动通过使异议显现，常常回应着人类对公平和道德秩序的深切渴望。雅伟通过先知阿摩司呼吁，愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔，提醒我们真正的公义应成为社会中不可否认的力量。这种对更公正世界的追求，往往需要勇气向权力说出真相，即使这意味着挑战现状。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: Chinese super-embassy in London to go ahead after high court challenge dismissed
title.zh: 中国驻伦敦超级大使馆在高院驳回挑战后将继续建设

summary.en: A high court in London has dismissed a challenge from local residents against the construction of a new Chinese embassy. The residents' association, which sought to stop planning permission, has announced its intention to appeal the ruling.
summary.zh: 伦敦高等法院驳回了当地居民对中国新大使馆建设的挑战。寻求阻止规划许可的居民协会表示将对该裁决提出上诉。

body.en: Royal Mint Court residents’ association, which sought to stop planning permission, says it will appeal against ruling Construction of a controversial new Chinese embassy was given the green light on Friday after the high court dismissed a challenge from neighbours. The Royal Mint Court residents’ association (RMCRA), which brought the case against the government, immediately announced plans to appeal against the decision, in a move that could cause further delays to the project. The debate over planning permission for the new embassy has been a sore point of British-Chinese relations in recent years. Continue reading...
body.zh: 寻求停止规划许可的皇家造币厂居民协会表示，在高等法院驳回邻国的质疑后，周五，有争议的中国新大使馆建设项目获得批准，该协会表示将对裁决提出上诉。对政府提起诉讼的皇家造币厂居民协会 (RMCRA) 立即宣布计划对该决定提出上诉，此举可能会导致该项目进一步延误。关于新使馆规划许可的争论一直是近年来英中关系的一个痛点。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Even amidst legal disputes and community tensions, the call to live peaceably with all people remains a guiding principle. While residents pursue their appeal, this situation reminds us of the ongoing effort required to foster good relationships, even between powerful entities and their neighbors. Yahweh desires that we strive for harmony wherever possible.
reflection.zh: 即使在法律纠纷和社区紧张局势中，与所有人和平相处的呼吁仍然是一个指导原则。当居民们继续上诉时，这种情况提醒我们，即使是强大的实体与邻里之间，也需要持续努力培养良好关系。雅伟希望我们尽可能地追求和谐。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Could AI take your job? Some workers in China already know the answer
title.zh: 人工智能会取代你的工作吗？中国一些工人已经知道了答案

summary.en: Workers across China are expressing concern about the potential impact of artificial intelligence on their jobs and livelihoods, amidst an already unstable labor market.
summary.zh: 在中国各地，工人们对人工智能在日益脆弱的劳动力市场中对其生计的影响感到担忧。

body.en: Across the country, workers are fearful about the impact of AI on their livelihoods in an increasingly fragile labour market On the tree-lined streets of Wuhan, where cars jostle for space with mopeds and cargo trucks, the malfunctioning of a new type of vehicle has recently been causing chaos on the city’s roads. In March, several cars from a fleet of driverless taxis stopped abruptly in the streets. The “system malfunction” left distressed riders stranded for hours. The robotaxis, known as Apollo Go and powered by artificial intelligence (AI), were taken off Wuhan’s streets for months for investigations. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在日益脆弱的劳动力市场中，全国各地的工人们都担心人工智能会对他们的生计产生影响。在武汉绿树成荫的街道上，汽车与轻便摩托车和货运卡车争夺空间，最近一种新型车辆的故障导致该市道路出现混乱。三月份，无人驾驶出租车车队中的几辆车突然停在街上。 “系统故障”让心疼的乘客滞留了几个小时。这辆名为 Apollo Go 的机器人出租车由人工智能 (AI) 驱动，已被带离武汉街道数月以进行调查。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As technological advancements like AI reshape the world of work, it's natural for people to feel anxious about their livelihoods. This verse reminds us that all our labor, when done with diligence and integrity, can be an offering to Yahweh, giving it enduring purpose beyond economic shifts. Even as job roles evolve, the dignity of human contribution...
reflection.zh: 随着人工智能等技术进步重塑工作世界，人们对生计感到焦虑是自然的。这节经文提醒我们，我们所有的劳动，只要勤勉正直地完成，都可以是献给雅伟的供物，使其超越经济变迁而拥有持久的意义。即使工作角色不断演变，人类贡献的尊严依然存在，植根于更高的呼召。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: The future of AI hinges on openness and cooperation. China and Britain can gain much by working together | Zheng Zeguang
title.zh: 人工智能的未来取决于开放与合作。中英两国携手合作可获益良多 | 郑泽光

summary.en: The Chinese ambassador to the UK, Zheng Zeguang, advocates for international cooperation between China and Britain in artificial intelligence development. He highlights the significant benefits of working together in areas such as manufacturing, healthcare, research, and governance, rather than competing in isolation.
summary.zh: 中国驻英国大使郑泽光呼吁中英两国在人工智能发展方面开展国际合作。他强调，两国在制造业、医疗保健、研究和治理等领域携手合作而非孤立竞争，将带来巨大的益处。

body.en: There is no point competing in isolation. There are so many benefits to be had, in manufacturing, healthcare, research and governance Zheng Zeguang is the Chinese ambassador to the UK Artificial intelligence is widely regarded as one of the defining technologies of our time. Like the steam engine, the harnessing of electricity and the internet before it, it has the potential to transform how we work, live and interact. But every technological revolution brings challenges as well as opportunities. As AI systems become more capable, people are asking legitimate questions. How can AI remain safe, accountable and under human control ? How should its development be governed? How can its benefits be shared more widely? Continue reading...
body.zh: 孤立地竞争是没有意义的。在制造、医疗保健、研究和治理方面有很多好处。郑泽光是中国驻英国大使人工智能被广泛认为是我们这个时代的决定性技术之一。就像蒸汽机、电力和互联网的利​​用一样，它有可能改变我们的工作、生活和互动方式。但每一次技术革命都带来挑战和机遇。随着人工智能系统变得越来越强大，人们提出了合理的问题。人工智能如何保持安全、负责任并处于人类控制之下？其发展又该如何治理？如何让更广泛的人分享其好处？继续阅读...

reflection.en: The call for nations to collaborate on AI development echoes the wisdom that collective counsel brings strength and stability. When leaders and experts from different backgrounds unite their insights, they can navigate complex challenges and unlock shared benefits for all.
reflection.zh: 呼吁各国在人工智能发展上合作，正应验了集体智慧带来力量和稳定的真理。当来自不同背景的领袖和专家汇聚洞见时，他们能够驾驭复杂的挑战，为所有人开启共同的益处。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Anthony Fauci’s diaries take aim at News Corp journalist Sharri Markson’s ‘nonsense’ Covid-19 investigation
title.zh: 安东尼·福奇的日记瞄准了新闻集团记者莎莉·马克森的“无稽之谈”的Covid-19调查

title.en: US-China AI rivalry heats up as Chinese models gain ground
title.zh: 中美人工智能竞争加剧，中国模型迎头赶上

summary.en: China's AI platforms are rapidly advancing, narrowing the gap with US technology. This progress has led to renewed threats from the Trump administration, alongside accusations of intellectual property theft, raising concerns about escalating tensions between the two nations.
summary.zh: 中国的人工智能平台正迅速缩小与美国同行的差距。这一进展引发了特朗普政府新的威胁，并伴随着知识产权盗窃的指控，令人担忧两国之间的紧张关系可能升级。

body.en:
China's AI platforms are rapidly closing the gap with their US counterparts, prompting fresh threats from the Trump administration. With accusations of intellectual property theft, could tensions boil over?

In what seems like the blink of an eye,  China has gone from being up to five years behind the United States in top-tier artificial intelligence (AI) to lagging by just a few months.

While US players, including Anthropic's Claude and OpenAI's ChatGPT , have spent hundreds of billions of dollars to push the frontier of AI, China has pursued a very different path .

Faced with US curbs on high-end chips that help AI to do its most advanced thinking, Chinese tech firms have prioritized dozens of open-source AI models built on "good enough"  technology .

These platforms, including DeepSeek, Alibaba's Qwen and Xiaomi's MiMo, are now widely deployed across Chinese businesses, government services and consumer devices.

In the latest sign of the gap closing, Chinese startup Moonshot AI last week unveiled Kimi K3, a model that rivals one of the most advanced AI models — Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 — on key benchmarks.

In some tests, Kimi K3 matches or even surpasses Claude with far less computing power and at a fraction of the cost. 

Global technology specialist Alvin W. Graylin thinks Kimi K3's arrival turns high-end AI from an expensive luxury into something practical and affordable.

"For 98% of customers, the 1 to 2% difference [in knowledge] isn't worth paying 10 to 20 times more."

China's latest advance has already drawn a strong reaction from Washington, with US President Donald Trump now threatening to block US access to Chinese AI models.

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, meanwhile, warned earlier this week that the US could sanction Chinese models over alleged intellectual property (IP) theft.

Anthropic  and OpenAI have accused Chinese labs of using their models to train their own systems, a process known as distilling.

While distilling is a common practice by AI labs worldwide to a limited extent, the companies say their models have been bombarded with queries to harvest advanced reasoning. The White House warned in April that China was doing it on an "industrial scale."

Beijing has hit back, rejecting the accusations as baseless and calling US threats of sanctions and model bans "technological bullying" to contain China's rise.

Giulia Neaher, a research analyst at the Strategic Foresight Hub at the Washington-based Stimson Center think tank, downplayed the role of distilling in Kimi's progress.

body.en:
WARNING: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander readers are advised that this story includes the name of an Indigenous person who has passed away.

When former AFL player for Essendon, Shawn Lewfatt, signed up as an Aboriginal Community Police Officer in Darwin in 1998, he was excited by the chance to work with his own people "for the better".

Now, he says, he would "never encourage" his adult children to join the Northern Territory Police Force (NTPF).

"My aim is that hopefully one day I can turn to young people and encourage them to join," he told SBS News.

Lewfatt is part of a landmark class action filed in the Federal Court against the NTPF seeking compensation for allegations of racial discrimination and racial vilification while serving as Aboriginal Community Police Officers (ACPOS) going back almost three decades.

"Our clients allege they were underpaid, provided fewer opportunities for career advancement and subjected to persistent racist conduct while serving communities across the NT," Seb O'Meara of Gordon Legal, who is representing the ACPOs in the class action, told SBS News.

The class action, run on behalf of all present and former Aboriginal police officers in the NT Police, seeks to speed up reform following the 2019 police shooting of Kumanjayi Walker and the subsequent inquest, which shone the spotlight on systemic racism within the NT Police Force.

A spokesperson for the NTPF told SBS News they were aware of ongoing legal proceedings, and it would be inappropriate to comment further.

Despite growing up in Darwin, Lewfatt told SBS News that when he walked through the doors of the police station, he felt like a "foreigner in my hometown".

"I felt immediately weird in the way they would speak about Aboriginal people, and it became clear to me that it was the norm."

Lewfett, who remains on the Force on leave, alleged he witnessed "unlawful assaults on Indigenous people", including one incident involving a non-Aboriginal police officer urinating into a wine cask belonging to an Aboriginal member of the public who had stashed it in a public toilet.

Lewfatt said that racism in the force is embedded in the culture, rather than in individuals.

"It's the systematic racism where there are a lot of good people who may not be racist but do not call out racism either when they come across it."

title.en: 'Free-range' eggs could face existential threat amid bird flu warning
title.zh: 禽流感警告下，‘散养’鸡蛋或面临生存威胁

summary.en: Experts are warning that the bird flu threat could end free-range egg farming, as confining birds to barns is now considered necessary for their welfare.
summary.zh: 专家警告称，禽流感威胁可能终结散养鸡蛋养殖，因为现在将禽鸟限制在禽舍内被认为是保障其福利的必要措施。

body.en:
The egg industry has so far remained unaffected by the H5N1 avian influenza (bird flu) outbreak; however, precautionary measures to limit the spread of the virus could drastically reduce free-range egg production.

The recent H5N1 outbreak in South Australia has sparked widespread concern for the health and safety of not only the wild bird population but also commercial farming.

Australian Eggs managing director Rowan McMonnies said the industry is "facing up to a riskier operating environment for the foreseeable future".

"Transmission between Australian wildlife indicates H5 avian influenza is established and is here to stay in the medium term," he said.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

McMonnies said whilst eradication "seems unlikely", the industry has been preparing for an outbreak of this type for several years.

"Important actions are being taken to address the risks. Strict biosecurity is being maintained with enhanced measures to deter wild birds and limit crossover into egg farms," he said.

"The industry has also worked closely with authorities to improve response processes based on overseas learnings so that where farms are impacted, they can bounce back faster, limiting any impact on egg supply."

Since 2018, the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC) has enforced the standard that for an egg product to be considered free range it must be laid by hens that have meaningful and regular access to outdoor range during daylight, are able to roam and forage in a stocking density of 10,000 hens or less per hectare, and that the density be displayed on produced products.

However, as of July, the ACCC confirmed it won’t take enforcement action for breaches of free-range egg labelling standards due to farms choosing to house birds inside for biosecurity reasons.

Limiting free-range environments is a biosecurity measure many chicken farms are using.

"The advice is to confine birds to sheds," microbiologist and food safety expert Associate Professor Julian Cox told SBS News.

"Birds of free-ranging pick up the virus and interact — potentially spreading it to noncommercial species .... or wild birds in the vicinity could bring it into commercial poultry that are free-ranging," he explained.

Cox said it’s a measure anyone who owns and cares for poultry should consider.

"If you've got some kind of coop, lock them in the coop. It’s for their own good."

As day turns to dusk at Waterloo Green park in Sydney's inner south, a crowd gathers to access free haircuts, optometry and dental check-up services.

There are snags on the barbecue and one attendant tells SBS News the Homelessness Week event — dubbed Refresh, Recharge & Shine — is "fantastic".

"There should be more things like this for people in need," Marie said while assisting at the event.

NSW housing and homelessness minister Rose Jackson, who was also there on 3 August, told SBS News she believes "people don't like to think about what it's like to be homeless" but that it was important to draw the issue into the national conversation.

"Knowing how many people are living homeless, where they are, what their demographic is, their age, their gender — that's critical information for the government."

Jackson said data collected during the Census of Population and Housing on 11 August will be "crucial" for allocating resources and services to people experiencing homelessness.

"I think the ABS [Australian Bureau of Statistics] has done a really good job lifting its level of engagement. I think maybe in the past it wasn't something that was recognised as a priority," Jackson said.

"The Census was built around [dropping] a form into people's letterbox — and for people that don't have letterboxes, where do you start?"

Sharon Callister, CEO of Mission Australia, has been working alongside Census field officers to help people experiencing housing insecurity complete the Census.

"There are rough sleepers in Sydney, and many of them are in known rough sleeping spots. Our support services staff go out there. There are also field offices coming from the Census office," she told SBS News.

She said people in temporary dwellings like boarding houses or hostels can access paper Census forms from accommodation staff.

Callister said it can be difficult to capture "hidden homeless" populations. That includes people sleeping in a car or tent, or couch surfing with friends, family or acquaintances without a secure lease.

"We're at a critical point in Australia. The last Census, there were [more than] 122,000 people homeless. We know from our services today that that number is going to be higher this year."

title.en: The growing constituency reshaping Australian politics

summary.en: A new study reveals that home ownership significantly impacts how Australians vote, indicating its growing influence on the nation's political landscape.
summary.zh: 一项新研究发现，房屋所有权影响澳大利亚人的投票方式，这表明它对该国政治格局的影响日益增长。

body.en:
The ongoing housing crisis is having severe repercussions on individuals and families in Australia. It has limited young people’s ability to move out, increased the rate of involuntary lifelong renting, and pushed vulnerable populations into homelessness.

These are not the only changes that flow as a result of housing unaffordability. Our new research demonstrates it’s also reshaping how people vote.

A longstanding body of academic work links individuals’ assets to their political and ideological beliefs, including the parties they vote for.

This literature shows people with more valuable assets are more likely to hold right-leaning political beliefs. They are also more likely to support conservative parties that favour the status quo over efforts to redistribute money and wealth more equitably throughout a society.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

For the average person, the family home is the most valuable asset they will ever own. However, surprisingly few studies have considered the influence of home ownership on voting preferences. Australia represents an interesting case study for two key reasons.

First, Australian major political parties differ in their electoral positions regarding housing policy. In particular, the Coalition of the Liberal and National parties has historically favoured homeowners through — for example — negative gearing and tax discounts. In contrast, since the 2010s, the Australian Greens and the Labor Party have progressively adopted more pro-renter stances.

Second, Australia’s trend towards housing unaffordability is particularly pronounced by international standards. This is reflected in increased home and rental prices, reduced homeownership rates and increased property-ownership concentration. This situation creates a greater divide in the economic interests of renters and homeowners, potentially shifting (or entrenching) party preferences.

Our new study explored how housing tenure relates to voting behaviour in Australia. We also wanted to know whether the relationship has become stronger over time.

We analysed survey data from more than 19,000 people participating in ten iterations of the Australian Election Study between 1996 and 2022. The Australian Electoral Study interviews people shortly after each national election, collecting information on their demographic traits, economic position and sociopolitical attitudes.

We analysed these survey data to examine associations between individuals’ self-reported housing tenure and the party they voted for in the last election. We also kept other relevant factors constant, such as age, income, area of residence...

Concerns about children and screen use may be overblown, new research suggests, with experts saying worries about an 'iPad baby' generation may be "premature".

A new international study, based on data from over 3,000 children, found no link between screen use duration and developmental difficulties at ages five or 10.

Researchers in the UK spoke with the families of children back in 2009 and 2010 and followed their development for the subsequent 10 years.

Over that time, there has been some criticism and debate about the role of technology in parenting, and whether young people born in the 21st century will be a screen-addicted generation.

The iPad was released in Australia in 2010, and a child growing up around this time is sometimes referred to as an 'iPad baby'.

While the findings are limited by self-reported survey data, Australian experts say the results counter popular messaging about parenting and technology.

"Fear from parents around screen time is unfounded and premature," Associate Professor David Armstrong from the School of Education at La Trobe University told SBS News.

"It's really a mixed bag over whether there are any adverse effects on kids' development, and it's good to note that there are some advantages of devices for social development."

He described the findings as "robust and methodical", saying they contribute to an emerging body of research calling not for less screen time, but for better use of it.

But Professor Andrew Whitehouse, an autism researcher at The Kids Research Institute Australia, said the findings should be taken with a grain of salt, as young children in 2026 have access to more smart devices than in 2009.

"The saturation of childhood by these devices came in the years afterwards," he said in a statement.

"This means that across early childhood, the children had almost no exposure to the ubiquity of smart devices as now exists."

As content increasingly targets children and is designed to maximise viewing time, experts say the best tools parents have are managing content and ensuring quality time away from screens.

Screen time is not inherently harmful said Adam Guastella, a clinical psychologist who works with Sydney Children's Hospital at Westmead and the University of Sydney.

Rather, the effects on a child's physical, cognitive and social development come down to content.

title.en: Could Australia's overseas emergency commitment leave us short at home?
title.zh: 澳大利亚可能无法永远依赖一项重要的消防措施

summary.en: Experts are cautioning that Australia may face increased competition for essential firefighting equipment in the future, a challenge that officials have acknowledged.
summary.zh: 专家警告称，澳大利亚未来在获取关键消防设备方面可能面临更大的竞争，官员们也承认了未来的“挑战”。

body.en:
From Spain to Greece, Europe is grappling with unprecedented wildfires that have killed dozens and forced hundreds of thousands of people to evacuate.

Australia is sending help, with two helicopters and dozens of NSW Rural Fire Service (RFS) personnel deploying to France in what is the state service's first-ever firefighting secondment to Europe.

But as Australia sends firefighters and aircraft north, the country's own bushfire season is approaching, which could be worsened by a strengthening El Niño.

For decades, Australia has benefited from a system in which firefighting crews and specialised aircraft can move between the Northern and Southern Hemispheres as fire seasons change.

Climate change is making those seasons longer and increasingly overlap, raising a question that could become increasingly important for Australia: what happens when everyone needs the same aircraft at the same time?

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The exchange of firefighting crews and aircraft between hemispheres is nothing new.

The RFS has been sending firefighters to North America for decades, with Canada and the United States returning the favour during Australia's summers.

Trent Penman, who leads the FLARE Wildfire Research group at the University of Melbourne, said Australia risks competing for aerial firefighting assets as the Northern and Southern Hemisphere fire seasons increasingly overlap.

"It's a risk that's already been realised both here in Australia and also in North America," he told SBS News.

He pointed to the southern California fires in January last year, which killed 30 people and destroyed 16,000 structures during the height of Australia's summer.

The bushfire season has traditionally followed a relatively predictable pattern, with early-season blazes in southern Queensland, while southern NSW and Victoria experienced fires later in the season.

"Now we're seeing fires starting earlier, but starting earlier in different areas as well," he said.

"We rely very heavily on volunteers in Australia, and so it is really stretching the capacity of our resources."

John Boag, CEO of Avincis, Europe's largest aerial emergency services firm, warned Europe is not prepared for longer and more extreme wildfire seasons, with firefighting aircraft increasingly needed almost year-round.

"Globally, fire seasons are getting longer, aircraft are not moving between areas and pilots are becoming harder and harder to get," Boag told Reuters.

That creates a potential problem for countries such as Australia, which have historically benefited from being able to draw on the same pool of specialised aircraft at different times of the year.

title.en: 'Steadfast advocate': Arnhem Land's Rirratjingu clan elder Bakamumu Marika dies
title.zh: “坚定的倡导者”：阿纳姆地Rirratjingu部落长老巴卡穆穆·马里卡去世

summary.en: Bakamumu Marika, a Rirratjingu clan elder from Arnhem Land, has passed away. He was known for his lifelong dedication to fighting for land rights and championing Indigenous people.
summary.zh: 阿纳姆地Rirratjingu部落长老巴卡穆穆·马里卡去世。他一生致力于为土地权利和原住民争取权益。

body.en:
A respected elder of Arnhem Land's Rirratjingu clan, Bakamumu Marika AM, has died, the clan group's Aboriginal corporation has announced.

"It is with profound sadness that we announce the passing of Bakamumu Marika AM, a highly respected Traditional Owner, elder and senior leader of the Rirratjingu Clan," the statement said.

Marika was a founder, long-serving chairman and current patron of the Rirratjingu Aboriginal Corporation who was appointed a Member of the Order of Australia (AM) in 2022 for his significant community service to North-East Arnhem Land.

As a "steadfast advocate" for land rights, Marika continued one of the most significant legacies in Australia’s Indigenous rights history, honouring and advancing the work of his forefathers, the statement reads.

A proud Rirratjingu man, cultural custodian and champion for his people, Marika dedicated his life to advancing opportunities in education, community development, economic participation and cultural preservation.

His commitment to working collectively, guided by Yolŋu values and traditions, strengthened his community and inspired younger generations to take pride in their culture and identity.

"We honour Bakamumu Marika's legacy and will forever be guided by his own words: 'We must continue to strive for a foundation that provides opportunity for our people. You will carry that responsibility along with my wish that unity and love continue to be the mark of the Rirratjingu people. I say to you, as my father said to me — ‘stand strong like the rock, Mandula'."

The Yothu Yindi Foundation (YYF), host of the Garma Festival , also expressed condolences following Marika's passing.

"Mr Marika was a beloved Yolŋu leader who devoted his life to his family and his people.

"His father, Roy Dadaynga Marika, is regarded as a founder of land rights, a legacy that he continued.

"As the founder and long-serving chairman of the Rirratjiŋu Aboriginal Corporation, he advocated tirelessly for his clan and all Yolŋu."

title.en: Two people seriously injured as building collapses in inner Sydney
title.zh: 悉尼市中心一栋建筑倒塌，两人受重伤

summary.en: Two people have been transported to hospital in serious condition after a building collapsed in inner Sydney.
summary.zh: 悉尼市中心一栋建筑倒塌，两人受重伤被送往医院。

body.en:
Two people have been hospitalised after a building collapsed in central Sydney on Monday, emergency services said.

A spokesperson for New South Wales Ambulance said it was called to an address in Ultimo, a suburb around 2 km from the city's central business district, just before 11am.

Workers assessed seven patients at the scene. According to ABC News, one man in his 60s and another in his 30s were removed from the rubble and rushed to hospital in a serious condition.

One of the men was taken to St Vincent's Hospital Sydney. The other was taken to Royal Prince Alfred Hospital.

Fire and Rescue New South Wales (FRNSW) told ABC News that the building was a construction site. Nearby buildings, including an adjoining service station, have been evacuated.
